meta.title: Refactor json-ast go nodes
meta.body_summary: Make Go json-ast nodes omit positions unless IncludePositions is enabled and regenerate the cross_join AST without position info to reduce output size.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit refactor making position inclusion optional in JSON AST nodes; merged instantly without review, likely pre-trusted by maintainer.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1446 changed lines, this is a large edit by absolute volume, but most deletions (1293 lines) are from regenerating the cross_join.go.json fixture without position fields. The core logic change in ast.go is only 28 lines. This fits a fast-turnaround infrastructure cleanup merged without review.

review_details.performance_claim: Positions in JSON AST nodes are omitted by default to reduce AST size and improve serialization/parsing performance.

core_change_summary.description: In tools/json-ast/x/go/ast.go, added an IncludePositions option to Node type and modified serialization to omit position fields when false. The cross_join.go.json test fixture was regenerated without any position properties, resulting in a net deletion of 1293 lines of position data.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The fixture file had 1293 lines of position fields removed; the ast.go logic change is 28 lines.
